summary: Hear and say number names in everyday settings.
Recognize and name the written numbers 0 to 10.
Connect written numbers with the amounts they stand for, up to 10.
Count up to 10 things one by one (up to 7 scattered), and see one more and one less as you count.
Compare groups of objects with words like more, less and the same.
Use objects to act out putting together and taking away, up to 5.
Notice length, area, weight and capacity, with words like long, tall, heavy, wide, big.
Compare two things: longer or shorter, heavier or lighter, holds more or less, or the same.
Sort and group objects by more than one feature.
Know that coins and dollars are money.
Say where things are: beside, inside, next to, near, above, below, apart.
Find and name flat shapes: circles, squares, triangles, rectangles.
Make and show solid shapes (ball, box, tube) with blocks, sticks and other materials.
